title: Mobile Bloom
description: Colorful street vendors carrying everything from fruit and candy to clothing and flowers are a common site in Hanoi, Vietnam, especially around Lunar New Year. While some opt for street stalls, many will load up their goods on a bike or motorbike instead. Photographer Martina Giammaria is often drawn to flowers in her work, and in this case, she "liked the idea that this person was almost entirely covered by those flowers, like they were growing on their body."
translated_description: 在越南河内，色彩缤纷的街头小贩随处可见，他们售卖从水果、糖果到服装、鲜花的各种商品，尤其是在农历新年期间。有些人选择摆摊，但许多人会把货物装在自行车或摩托车上。摄影师玛蒂娜·贾玛利亚在工作中常常被鲜花吸引，而在这次拍摄中，她“喜欢这个人几乎完全被那些花遮住的感觉，就像花是从他们身上长出来的一样。”
